integrity: The universal upper bound is analytic. Achievability uses an explicitly Gaussian filter from arXiv:2609.15059v1 and its particle-hole conjugate. The Bell endpoint and unrestricted-LOCC comparison are cross-checked against the cited primary sources. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact one-copy result for finite-round fine-grained single-Kraus GSLOCC on one fermionic mode per party; no claim for unresolved multi-Kraus Gaussian instruments, catalysis, asymptotic rates, or approximate conversion. Conventions admitting local parity-changing generalized Gaussian corrections are assumed.
title: Exact single-copy GSLOCC conversion frontier for two-mode fermionic Gaussian entanglement
